provenance.prompt: Purpose: four real original tabletop makeup mirrors using the shared vanity top support, bounded planar reflection and warm-white local spotlight. Model in metres with +Y up, +Z toward the user and a bottom-centre origin, within a .70 x .60 x .16m envelope. Preserve the .24 x .03 x .14m closed base, real intersecting post/back support and actual upper lamp housing containing [0,.585,.065]. Each declared pane is a finite convex contour at its own exact plane, with thick backing, unobstructed interior and a closed frame. Bake every vertex into resource space with identity node transforms. Do not add textures, animations or external models. Keep at most 2500 triangles, 32 meshes and four materials. Rebuild deterministically with the pinned Three.js exporter and validate the actual loaded GLB through the independent geometry gate. Design: A real .40 x .36m rectangular pane surrounded by a broad cream metal light-fixture frame and a separate overhead diffuser. Closed back, central pedestal and actual lamp bridge.
provenance.method: Original closed parametric base/post/back/frame/lamp geometry. Finite convex pane contours and distinct tri-fold plane transforms are baked into Float32 resource-space vertices. Deterministic GLTFExporter with actual GLTFLoader readback and independent makeup-mirror geometry admission.
limitations: Broad fixed frame and overhead warm-white diffuser. No variable color temperature.
